messages:
harry: Quick alert 7:30 UTC window tonight for cross-service deploy. Sequence proposed: runtime 2.9.0 -> api 1.14.0 -> router 4.7. Contains a DB migration for console (non-blocking read path) that must run after router is stable. Any objections?
meera: No objections. Important: the DB migration adds a new nullable column and a backfill job; we must ensure the api header flip (x-rdwd-meta) is gated before enabling backfill.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: runtime@2.9.0, api@1.14.0(ff:header_meta_v1), router@4.7. Start 17:30 UTC. Running preflight checks... :robot_face:
ops: Preflight: infra OK; two hosts show higher io latency, recommend lowering pod concurrency there. Staging tests passed but saw an intermittent header-parse warn in api staging logs.
harry: Canary plan: runtime quick 5% for 6m, api 5% for 8m behind FF, ramp to 25% for 10m, then router full. DB migration only after router stable 10m and console FF on. Halt triggers: api/router 5xx >1.5% or p95 +200ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows.
meera: Add console signal: console/migration-failure >0.1% OR backfill retries >3k -> immediate hold and FF kill. Also track db/locks and migration-duration.
console-captain: We'll run the migration in two phases: ddl (safe add) then async backfill. Backfill will be disabled until we confirm router+api stability. I'll keep the backfill-runner ready to pause.
trace-bot: Enabling 100% trace sampling on /v1/* for api during canary (first 20m). Traces posted to #eng-trace.
harry: Rollback playbook (copyable):
```
# rollback api to previous
deploy-bot rollback api@1.14.0 -> api@1.13.3
# rollback runtime
kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/runtime runtime:2.8.4
# unpin if runtime fails
deploy-bot unpin api
deploy-bot unpin router
# hold console migration
console-captain pause-backfill
```
meera: Small staging nit: header normalization when multiple metadata headers present; 1.14.0 normalizes but watch logs api.header.normalize.warn > 20/min.
ops: I'll seed dashboards: api/header-latency, api/5xx, router/retry-rate, runtime/kv-evict, db/migration-progress, console/migration-errors. Will add synthetic hitting the header path.
harry: Release notes draft to post after success: "runtime: KV eviction and perf; api: metadata header contract (opt-in FF); router: smoother backpressure; console: staged DB migration (FF-controlled backfill)"
deploy-bot: preflight results: images signed, smoke tests passed for runtime+api, router smoke queued. Post-deploy hooks: migration-checker -> schema-verify -> e2e-smoke. If migration-checker fails, deploy-bot will mark failure and queue rollback.
meera: Emergency decision tree: if api canary fails, disable `api.header_meta_v1` FF, rollback api to 1.13.3, and hold console. If runtime node-level issues detected, unpin API/router and rollback runtime. If db backfill shows locks/slow > threshold, pause backfill and escalate.
console-captain: I'll keep the migration playbook and rollback SQL in this thread for ops. Quick SQL rollback snippet:
```
-- backfill pause: insert into migration_control (name, state) values ('console_backfill','paused');
-- ddl rollback (rare): ALTER TABLE console DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS new_meta;
```
ops: PagerDuty: oncall set harry (primary), meera (secondary). Pages route to #oncall-ops.
harry: Kicking at 17:30 UTC. Keep all rollback signals and manual unpin commands in this thread. Ping @meera for emergency FF kill. Good luck.
